title: Look
intro: A mine sits behind the target. Observe near the peak of the green curve, before the packet spreads onto the mine.
goal: Observe while P_T is near its peak, before the packet reaches the mine.
naiveSkip: tutorial on timing: the naive check already observes at the best moment

tutorial.title: Timing
tutorial.text: A mine sits behind the target. The faint curves preview the odds over time: green for the target, red for the mine.
tutorial.phys: Too early, the particle is probably still on its way. Too late, ψ has spread onto the mine. You choose when to roll the dice.

tutorial.title: Pick your moment
tutorial.text: Press Play, then Observe when the green ring is near its peak.

tutorial.title: A hundred tries
tutorial.text: The dots are 100 runs of exactly this setup: about P<sub>T</sub> of them hit. Retry a few times. The outcome changes, P<sub>T</sub> does not.

physics.point: The Born rule gives odds, not outcomes. The same ψ observed twice can give different answers, so judge a run by P_T, not by the result.

idea: Quantum mechanics predicts frequencies. Prepare the same ψ many times, measure each copy, and the fraction found in the target approaches P<sub>T</sub>. A single run tells you almost nothing about whether P<sub>T</sub> was high.
That is why stars come from P<sub>T</sub> at the moment you observed. The dice only decide whether a hit happened.
Timing matters because ψ keeps moving. The probability flows into the target, peaks, and then flows on, here onto a mine.
maths: Each observation is a Bernoulli trial with success probability P<sub>T</sub>. Over n runs the number of hits has mean nP<sub>T</sub> and standard deviation √(nP<sub>T</sub>(1 − P<sub>T</sub>)).
In this level P<sub>T</sub> peaks at 49% around t = 9.2. By t = 14 it is down to 14% while the mine holds 16%.
try: Observe at the peak five times and count hits. Then observe at t ≈ 14 five times and count mines.
Turn on expectation mode in Settings: the dice are removed and you win when P<sub>T</sub> is above 30%. It shows what you control.
